code: # Needs Linux with processx, ps, prlimit and nice, and a package library # without symbolic links. R CMD check links the packages into a temporary # library when it limits them to the declared dependencies # (_R_CHECK_SUGGESTS_ONLY_, which --as-cran turns on, or # _R_CHECK_DEPENDS_ONLY_). A run starts a guardian and a worker process and # pins every installed file they load, which takes a while. # \donttest{ roots <- c("reflowR", "processx", "ps", "digest", "base") usable <- identical(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], "Linux") &&   requireNamespace("processx", quietly = TRUE) &&   requireNamespace("ps", quietly = TRUE) && ps::ps_is_supported() &&   nzchar(Sys.which("prlimit")) && nzchar(Sys.which("nice")) if (usable) {   # Three depth presets: minimal (3 steps), standard (8 steps), extended (12 steps). Custom SVG icons per scheme embedded navbar. CSS/SCSS theme generation colour scheme definitions. reflow_preview() interactive colour preview. reflow_schemes() reflow_presets() convenience functions. Full compatibility workflowr commands (wflow_build, wflow_publish, etc.). Two vignettes: Getting Started Colour Schemes Reference.
